# --- tentacle tube builder ---
def catmull(points, samples=28):
    pts=[Vector(p) for p in points]
    # pad ends
    ext=[pts[0]+(pts[0]-pts[1])*0.5]+pts+[pts[-1]+(pts[-1]-pts[-2])*0.5]
    out=[]
    segs=len(pts)-1
    per=max(2, samples//segs)
    for i in range(segs):
        p0,p1,p2,p3=ext[i],ext[i+1],ext[i+2],ext[i+3]
        for j in range(per):
            t=j/per; t2=t*t; t3=t2*t
            out.append(0.5*((2*p1)+(-p0+p2)*t+(2*p0-5*p1+4*p2-p3)*t2+(-p0+3*p1-3*p2+p3)*t3))
    out.append(pts[-1])
    return out

def tentacle(name, points, r0, r1, material, sucker_mat=None):
    path=catmull(points, samples=30)
    n=len(path); sides=12
    verts=[]; faces=[]
    # frames: use tangent + world up fallback
    for i, p in enumerate(path):
        t = (path[min(i+1,n-1)]-path[max(i-1,0)])
        if t.length==0: t=Vector((0,0,1))
        t.normalize()
        up=Vector((0,0,1))
        if abs(t.dot(up))>0.92: up=Vector((0,1,0))
        side=t.cross(up); side.normalize()
        upv=side.cross(t); upv.normalize()
        frac=i/(n-1)
        # ease taper, slightly bulbous at base
        r = r0*(1-frac)+r1*frac
        r *= (1 - 0.15*math.sin(frac*math.pi)*0)  # keep simple
        for j in range(sides):
            a=2*math.pi*j/sides
            dirv=side*math.cos(a)+upv*math.sin(a)
            verts.append(p+dirv*r)
    for i in range(n-1):
        for j in range(sides):
            a=i*sides+j; b=i*sides+(j+1)%sides; c=(i+1)*sides+j; d=(i+1)*sides+(j+1)%sides
            faces.append((a,c,d,b))
    # caps: add center verts
    # start cap fan and end cap fan handled by adding tip sphere later; add faces closing with centroid
    mesh=bpy.data.meshes.new(name+"Mesh")
    mesh.from_pydata(verts, [], faces); mesh.update()
    obj=bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(obj)
    for p in mesh.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
    if material: mesh.materials.append(material)
    # tip sphere
    tip=path[-1]
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=16, ring_count=8, location=tip)
    tip_o=bpy.context.active_object; tip_o.name=name+"_tip"; tip_o.scale=(r1,r1,r1)
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    for p in tip_o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
    if material: tip_o.data.materials.append(material)
    # suckers: small flattened spheres along underside (facing down/front)
    if sucker_mat:
        for k in range(3, n-4, 4):
            p=path[k]; frac=k/(n-1); r=r0*(1-frac)+r1*frac
            # underside offset: down-ish

            bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=12, ring_count=6, location=loc)
            s=bpy.context.active_object; s.name=f"{name}_sucker{k}"; s.scale=(r*0.42,r*0.42,r*0.22)
